title: MCP list_actions lists a deployment-authored action on a packaged object twice, attributing one row to the package's namespace, and refuses its AI face as ambiguous
body:
qa#3 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibw6yXcLi9aRRBpPT4W

## Reproduction (fresh stock showcase at ee9ad834, admin; reproduced on two fresh boots)

1. `PUT /api/v1/meta/action/qa_ai_gated` with no `?package=`, body `{name:'qa_ai_gated', label:'QA AI gated', objectName:'showcase_task', operation:'update', patch:{progress:50}, execution:'perRecord', ai:{exposed:true, description:'a description of 40+ chars'}}` → 200.
2. `GET /api/v1/meta/action` lists qa_ai_gated once, with `_packageId` null.
3. MCP `tools/call list_actions {}` with an admin osk_ key returns:
   - **two** qa_ai_gated rows on showcase_task, one with `namespace:"showcase"` and one without;
   - `refusedFaces[0].face` = `showcase_task-qa_ai_gated`, "derived for 2 actions: … of namespace "showcase"; … authored in this environment".
4. `run_action {actionName:'showcase_task-qa_ai_gated'}` → 404 "Action face … names no one action". The bare name and `namespace:'showcase'` both run it.

Expected: one row with no namespace (the action is environment-authored), and its face resolves. The action was never shipped by com.example.showcase.

## Mechanism (read from source, not proven)

The authored action is merged into showcase_task's embedded `actions`; `GET /meta/object/showcase_task` lists qa_ai_gated among them. `collectActionDeclarations` (`packages/runtime/src/action-execution.ts:5160-5189`) files that embedded copy under `declaringPackageOf(action) ?? declaringPackageOf(obj)`, which is com.example.showcase. The standalone copy's holder is ''. The ADR-0150 D4 dedupe keys on the holder package, so the two copies are not collapsed.

Related, closed: #32437 (list_actions listed one action once per bound object).
